grows_up.narrative: HubSpot matures like established software companies: seats keep growing while credits add a second meter, growth fades from ~13% to ~4% by year 10, and SBC discipline plus operating leverage lift FCF after SBC to 25% of revenue (low-middle of the mature-peer range) by year 7.

evidence.claim: FCF after SBC margin rose from -8.4% (FY2023) to 1.6% (FY2025) to 4.2% (TTM Jun-26) as SBC fell from 19.9% to 14.9% of revenue
Management targets by 2030: 30% non-GAAP operating margin, 20% GAAP operating margin, SBC at 10% of revenue; 23-24% non-GAAP operating margin in 2027
evidence.source: HubSpot Analyst Day 17 Sep 2026, CFO K. Bueker (earningscalls.dev transcript, grade C); existence of the targets confirmed in HubSpot 8-K filed 2026-10-06 ('remains confident in achieving its longer-term operating margin targets shared at its Analyst Day')

evidence.claim: Seats are still growing: paid seat count +16% YoY and seat ARR +23%; >2.5M paid seats at end of Q2 2026
evidence.source: HubSpot Analyst Day 17 Sep 2026, CEO Y. Rangan (earningscalls.dev transcript, grade C)

evidence.claim: Peer seat-based model still expanding: Atlassian FY2026 subscription revenue +27%, 'primarily attributable to paid seat expansion from our existing customers and price increases'
Cost actions: 7% workforce reduction announced 1 Oct 2026, with management 'confident' in its longer-term operating margin targets

squeezed.narrative: AI pressure on per-seat software stops HubSpot maturing: agents and credits are priced down, customers downgrade and swap seats for credits, so growth fades fast from ~11% to 3% by year 6, and AI compute costs absorb the SBC savings, so FCF after SBC stalls at 12% of revenue (about half the mature-peer level) by year 5.

evidence.claim: Growth is decelerating fast: Q3 2026 revenue guided +14% vs +20% in Q2; FY2026 guidance implies H2 2026 growth of ~14%; net new ARR growth expected below constant-currency revenue growth
evidence.source: HubSpot 8-K Ex. 99.1, 5 Aug 2026 (guidance); Q2 2026 earnings call, CFO (Motley Fool transcript)

evidence.claim: Retention weakening under budget pressure: NRR 102% (-1 pt YoY); 'continued seat and credit expansion was offset by other net upgrade headwinds as a result of customer budget optimization'; 'downgrade pressure'
evidence.source: HubSpot Q2 2026 earnings call, 5 Aug 2026, CFO K. Bueker and CEO Y. Rangan (Motley Fool transcript)

evidence.claim: AI pricing deflation: outcome-based agent pricing, price cuts on several key agents (April 2026) and lower entry prices; customers want flexibility 'to swap seats for credits'
evidence.source: HubSpot Q2 2026 release (CEO: 'evolving our product, pricing, and go-to-market'), 8-K 5 Aug 2026; Q2 2026 earnings call (Motley Fool transcript)

evidence.claim: AI raises the cost base: GAAP gross margin fell from 85.0% (FY2024) to 83.8% (FY2025) to 82.4% (Q2 2026); management expects COGS growth to outpace revenue growth in 2027 to fund agent capacity
evidence.source: modules/01-fact-pack Exhibit 1; HubSpot Analyst Day 17 Sep 2026, CFO (earningscalls.dev transcript)

evidence.claim: Net customer additions of ~7,000 in Q2 2026 missed the 9,000-10,000 expected; H2 guided to ~5,000-6,000 per quarter
evidence.source: HubSpot Q2 2026 earnings call (Motley Fool transcript)
